title.zh: CZ Alleges Hackers Bought CryptoBilis as Ledger Probes Wallet Drains
title.en: CZ Alleges Hackers Bought CryptoBilis as Ledger Probes Wallet Drains

current_state.zh: CZ alleges that hackers acquired Ledger reseller CryptoBilis, while Ledger investigates wallet drains, with the reseller's former founders saying they handed over operations in March under an agreement that delayed public disclosure until mid-October.
